Portfolio

A few sites we have built

A small selection of some of our recent work.

Service Business

Hair Play Sarasota

Hairplay offers a service that's a little outside the box, so the website needed to make it easy to understand without taking away from what makes it unique. We built a clean, visually appealing site that quickly shows visitors what Hairplay is, what the experience is like, and what to expect. The booking integration is right there on the page, so once someone is interested, there's no hunting around for how to book. A clear funnel straight from “what is this?” to making an appointment.

Service

Make It Real

Make It Real needed a website that could do more than explain what they offer. It needed to help people figure out where they are in the process and take the next step. We built an engaging, interactive experience that guides visitors through their options, funnels potential clients through a tailored quiz, and turns an overwhelming “I have an idea” into a clear path forward. The result is a site that reflects the approachable, practical nature of the business while actively helping turn curious visitors into qualified leads.

Portfolio

Dizzy / QDHM Productions

Dizzy / QDHM Productions needed a place to showcase their work in a way that felt personal to the artist. This build was especially collaborative, with the artist having a strong vision for how she wanted her portfolio to look, feel, and function. We brought that vision to life while organizing her work into a site that makes it easy for visitors to explore her projects and get a feel for her creative style. The result is a portfolio that feels distinctly hers.
